Operating cash flow and company-defined free cash flow rose, but cash flow timing within a quarter is not evidence of a durable earnings improvement. Cost of revenues rose while selling, general and administrative costs fell, and interest expense remained a large fixed claim ahead of pretax results. Because the selected rows omit the reconciliation of non-GAAP measures, the composition of other operating expense, net, guidance, and any year-over-year context, the thesis cannot be upgraded or downgraded on this extract; the appropriate research state is a preserved hold pending a fuller filing-based review.
